title: Run credential answer
description: The body of the adapter's signed 200 answer to the call with the path run-credential (run-credential.schema.json), application/json: the credential, as the Forager contract's credential document (credential.schema.json), with its version 1, narrowed so that the control plane seals the member token as the member value of the run's sealed value, and the members expires_at and apply unchanged; it does not seal version. The narrowing: the member token is required at the top level, and is 1 to 16384 bytes of UTF-8 with no NUL, no carriage return and no line feed, and no space or tab at its start or its end; the schema states the length only as 16384 characters, since a schema counts characters, and the control plane counts bytes. No apply item has a member token, so the credential is one secret. Each host of each apply item is exact, a DNS name with no *. at its start. placeholders is refused, because placeholders come only from the run configuration. expires_at is optional; when present, it is later than the time of the call the answer is bound to, which the schema cannot check and the control plane refuses otherwise; absent, the credential does not expire. The control plane refuses an answer with an apply item outside the run configuration's credential entry it asked for: a host outside the entry's hosts, another scheme, username or header, or paths that the entry's paths do not cover. The entry's apply items are the apply items of the source role in the adapter's description (description.schema.json), with {target.path} in each path template filled with the path of the run's target. An answer may narrow its entry and never widen it. The answer is signed with the adapter's access key, bound to the call's signature, as definitions.schema.json describes an answer to a call, and names the revision it was built for in revision. The control plane never logs the access token, the value of token. The control plane refuses a member this schema does not define.

version.description: The document format. The control plane refuses a version it does not read.

revision.description: The contract revision the adapter built the answer for, the one the call's X-Qory-Contract-Version named. The control plane refuses an answer whose revision is not the call's.

credential.description: The credential: the Forager contract's credential document, version 1 included, narrowed as this schema's description says.

token.description: The secret, 1 to 16384 bytes of UTF-8 with no NUL, carriage return or line feed, and no space or tab at its start or its end.
